'''Vil'pak''' was a [[Chelidae]] who worked in maintenance on the ''[[Colossus]]'' on [[Castilon]]. Vil'pak was responsible for catching [[Kel]] and [[Eila]] as they jumped out of the [[Colossus Engineering Level|''Colossus'' Engineering Level]] to evade [[Pyre]] and his [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtroopers]].<ref name="The Children from Tehar" />
